root_cause.text: The caiaq driver stored a pointer to the parent USB device without taking a reference (usb_get_dev), and in the card’s private_free callback it called usb_reset_device on that device — both of which can lead to use-after-free and/or locking issues when the callback runs asynchronously after the USB device has been disconnected and freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `usb_get_dev(usb_dev)` when assigning `cdev->chip.dev` and replaces `usb_reset_device(cdev->chip.dev)` with `usb_put_dev(cdev->chip.dev)` in `card_free()`. The CVE description explicitly states that the private_free callback can run after the USB device is already freed, and that `usb_reset_device` in a teardown context is inappropriate.
